biotools.summary: InPheRNo-ChIP is a computational framework for reconstructing phenotype-relevant gene regulatory networks associated with endoderm development. It integrates RNA-seq, transcription factor (TF)-specific ChIP-seq, and phenotypic labels to infer GRNs.
